arguments.subject: RE: why am I being logged out every time I switch machines?
arguments.body:
Hi Maya,

Thank you for reaching out and for describing the issue in detail. I understand how disruptive it is to have your sign-in session end every time you switch devices—especially with your Pro plan workflow across multiple machines.

Based on current Cursor policies and documentation, there is NO intended change or new policy restricting simultaneous sign-in sessions across devices for users signed in via Google SSO. Being logged out on one machine when signing in on another is not expected or documented behavior for Cursor. This issue is not related to billing, payment method changes, or known policies.

Since this started only a few days ago after working fine for a year, this looks like a possible bug or unexpected session handling change.

To resolve this quickly, a human support engineer will need to review your account session logs to determine what changed and why your sessions are not persisting as expected. I am escalating your ticket now so you get a direct follow-up.

We genuinely apologize for the disruption, and you will receive a real answer from our human support team as soon as possible.

Thank you for your patience,
Lyra Support Bot
Cursor Support Team

arguments.subject: RE: Invoice PDF won't download
arguments.body:
Hi Daniel,

Thanks for reaching out about your March invoice download issue.

This is usually due to a browser or network issue affecting the download or a temporary glitch with the invoice archive. Please try the following steps:

1. Refresh the invoice page and try again.
2. Try downloading the invoice using a private/incognito tab.
3. If you are using any browser extensions (such as ad blockers or privacy tools), try disabling them temporarily.
4. Ensure that cookies are enabled for billing.cursor.com, as blocking these can sometimes interrupt PDF downloads.

If you continue to experience issues, let us know which browser and OS you're using, and we can issue the PDF by email or escalate for further review.

Best regards,
Lyra Support Bot
Cursor Support Team

I've logged your request for a one-step keyboard shortcut as a feature request. While I can't promise timelines, feedback from power users like you is a key driver for new shortcut additions. Please keep an eye on release notes for any updates.

Let us know if you have other suggestions or need help with custom workflows!

Best,
Lyra Support Bot
Cursor Support Team

arguments.subject: RE: Invoice PDF won't download
arguments.body:
Hi Daniel,

Thanks for reaching out about your March invoice download issue.

This is usually due to a browser or network issue affecting the download or a temporary glitch with the invoice archive. Please try the following steps:

1. Refresh the invoice page and try again.
2. Try downloading the invoice using a private/incognito tab.
3. If you are using any browser extensions (such as ad blockers or privacy tools), try disabling them temporarily.
4. Ensure that cookies are enabled for billing.cursor.com, as blocking these can sometimes interrupt PDF downloads.

If you continue to experience issues, let us know which browser and OS you're using, and we can issue the PDF by email or escalate for further review.

Best regards,
Lyra Support Bot
Cursor Support Team

arguments.subject: RE: Feature request: keyboard shortcut for inline edit
arguments.body:
Hi Riya,

Thanks for your feedback and suggestion.

Currently, there is no dedicated keyboard shortcut that directly triggers inline edit without using cmd-K and then clicking. Your workflow is correct—cmd-K opens the command bar, and manual selection is required for inline edit.

I've logged your request for a one-step keyboard shortcut as a feature request. While I can't promise timelines, feedback from power users like you is a key driver for new shortcut additions. Please keep an eye on release notes for any updates.

Let us know if you have other suggestions or need help with custom workflows!

Best,
Lyra Support Bot
Cursor Support Team
